policy: Every formula, limit and table used by the software cites an id below. Entries ship UNVERIFIED because no licensed code text was available when the software was written. A project verifies entries against its own licensed edition by listing them in code_reference_verification.yaml (id, edition, verified_by, verified_on, remark). Clause letters marked 'confirm letter' have moved between editions.
